newton_stock_smoke.scope: Stock Newton platform/runtime validation only; not Q1 native environment or gait acceptance.

q1_unchanged.legacy_without_headless_error: AppLauncher requires Isaac Sim / Omniverse Kit; Isaac Sim not installed in Newton-only environment

migration_required: Replace AppLauncher with launch_simulation and configure explicit Newton physics preset; --headless removed (headless is default).
Convert robot and contact sensor ProxyArray data accesses to .torch or native Warp.
Convert WXYZ quaternion assumptions and constants to XYZW.
Use *_index or *_mask articulation state and target write methods.
Revalidate normal and friction contact force semantics, stop criteria, material/friction settings, actuator and limit equivalence.
Native 23-joint asset/FK/COM/inertia/contact/torque regression plus reset-free first-step/four-step gates must pass before any production training backend switch.
recommendation: Keep current validated PhysX production training isolated. Lab3 Newton is viable on this Spark as a separate migration and matched-physics benchmark candidate, but no Q1 throughput/realism superiority was measured.

ovphysx_stock_smoke.scope: Same stock task platform validation, not Q1 6144-env throughput or convergence. Cold first-run Newton kernel compile makes these short timings unsuitable to select production backend.

q1_newton_urdf_import.scope: Importer only, no dynamic simulation, no Q1 policy or contact validation, no performance conclusion.
